## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] Tests cover the change
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line in the newest version, its top section, for any user-visible change
- [ ] Docs, examples and test fixtures use placeholder data only (`My Site`, `sftp.example.com`, `demo-user`)
- [ ] Checked in a light, a dark and a high contrast theme, if the change shows anything
- [ ] No new runtime dependency, or its licence and reason are given below, and `npm run notices` was run
